# authwise_audience_config (Data Source)

An audience's config: its token lifetimes, scopes, CORS and Access settings. Builds the AudienceConfig message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_audience.config` takes. Makes no API calls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An API that is not an OpenID audience, with roles in its tokens.
data "authwise_audience_config" "this" {
  access_token_expire_seconds = 600

  scopes = {
    openid        = false
    authorization = { include_roles = true }
  }
}

resource "authwise_audience" "this" {
  display_name = "https://api.example.com"
  config       = data.authwise_audience_config.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds. Unset takes the value from the layer above (tenant, issuer, audience, client).
- `authorization` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization))
- `cors` (Attributes) The browser origins allowed to call kit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors))
- `flow_integration_config` (Attributes) The endpoint kit calls during the login flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flow_integration_config))
- `interaction_forward_uri` (String)
- `refresh_token_absolute_expire_seconds` (Number) Hard cap on a refresh token family in seconds, set once when the family is created. Unset takes the value from the layer above.
- `refresh_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Refresh token idle lifetime in seconds: it slides forward on every rotation. Unset takes the value from the layer above.
- `scopes` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of AudienceConfig, for `authwise_audience.config`.

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `authorization.access`

Optional:

- `decision_sampling` (Number) The percentage of ALLOW decisions recorded as `access.decision` audit events, 0-100. DENY is always recorded.
- `default_resource_expander_endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint for pull-mode resource-parent expansion when a resource type names none.
- `default_subject_expander_endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint for pull-mode subject-group expansion.
